mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversion_job (job_id, source_file_id, conversion_type, status, options, progress) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{sourceFileId}, #{conversionType}, #{status}, #{options}, #{progress})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversion_job WHERE source_file_id = #{sourceFileId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM conversion_job ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE conversion_job SET status = 'COMPLETED', progress = 100, output_file_id = #{outputFileId}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
UPDATE conversion_job SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
